# NMX Labs

> NMX Labs is a creative & performance marketing studio based in Gurugram, India,
> serving clients worldwide. We combine brand design with Meta Ads performance so
> the creative and the media are built together.

## What we do
- Branding & Identity — starter brand system from Rs 25,000 (discovery, logo, colour & type system, social assets, mini guidelines).
- Social Media Creative — Rs 8,000 / month, 8 custom static/carousel creatives (design only).
- Campaign Creative — Rs 10,000 per campaign (concept, key visual, 3-5 adaptations).
- Meta Ads Management — Rs 8,000 / month (setup, audience research, weekly optimisation, reporting; ad spend billed separately).
- Creative + Meta Ads bundle — Rs 15,000 / month + ad spend (creative and media buying combined).
- Brand & Marketing Design — from Rs 7,500 (decks, brochures, collateral).

## Who we work with
D2C brands, EV & energy, SaaS, hospitality and creator-led businesses, from pre-launch to post-Series A.
